component.name: renderHAM
component.summary: Convert images to Amiga HAM6 pictures and animations

description.p: renderHAM converts photos and other images into Amiga HAM6 IFF/ILBM files, with palette control, dithering, cropping and a Ken Burns-style pan-and-zoom animation preview and export (IFF ANIM).

The package contains the graphical application renderHAMgui and the command-line tool renderHAM. The software is AI-generated: the code was written by Claude (Anthropic) under the direction of rawbit (@ravvbit).
